vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: compound-eng-file-todos
Version: 3.0.3

The skill bundle provides a legitimate and well-documented system for managing project tasks via Markdown files in a dedicated directory. It includes templates (todo-template.md), workflows, and standard bash utility commands (grep, ls, awk) for searching and triaging tasks. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection was found; all operations are localized to task management.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only file-based todo tracking skill (templates and workflow docs) and its requirements and instructions are consistent with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the provided files: templates, workflows, and quick-reference shell snippets for managing markdown todo files in a todos/ directory. Nothing in the package requests unrelated credentials, binaries, or system access.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the referenced docs only describe creating, renaming, searching, and editing markdown files in a todos/ directory and include example shell commands (ls, grep, mv, cp). References to slash commands and 'gh CLI' are advisory; the skill does not include steps that read unrelated system files, exfiltrate data, or send information to unexpected endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. This minimizes risk because nothing is downloaded or written by an installer.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. The docs mention possible integration with tools like gh CLI, but no credentials are declared or required by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and disable-model-invocation is true (the skill will not autonomously invoke models). The skill does not request persistent installation or modify other skills/configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a collection of templates and workflow instructions for keeping todos as markdown files — it appears safe and coherent. Before you use it: (1) review any shell commands (grep, cp, mv, ls) before running them to avoid accidental file changes; (2) if you integrate with external tools (gh CLI, slash commands, or automation that interacts with PRs), ensure those integrations are configured separately and that you only provide tokens/credentials to trusted tools; and (3) confirm the todos/ path and file-naming conventions match your repo to avoid accidental renaming or moves. If you need the skill to operate against GitHub or other services automatically, expect to supply those credentials outside this skill and re-evaluate the security implications at that time.
